sentences.text: Lisa T. Su has served as president and chief executive officer of Advanced Micro Devices and a member of its board since October 2014, and as chair of the board since February 2022.

sentences.quote: Born in Taiwan, Su grew up in Queens, New York. After earning bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees in electrical engineering from MIT, she worked at Texas Instruments, IBM, and Freescale Semiconductor, then joined AMD in 2012.
sentences.text: Born in Taiwan and raised in Queens, New York, she earned bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees in electrical engineering from MIT and worked at Texas Instruments, IBM and Freescale Semiconductor before joining AMD in 2012.

She joined AMD as senior vice president and general manager of global business units and served as chief operating officer before being named president and CEO; at Freescale she had been senior vice president and general manager of networking and multimedia.
As chair and CEO she has led AMD's shift toward high-performance and adaptive computing, with growth across data center and artificial intelligence, client computing, gaming and embedded solutions.
